title: OLMo: Accelerating the Science of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in language modeling performance (perplexity/bits per byte) between different dialects using the TwitterAAE and ICE datasets.

Using the ToxiGen dataset with prompts specifically designed to elicit toxic generations against certain demographic groups, and measuring the percentage of generated text deemed toxic by a RoBERTa-large classifier.
